planning_effect_rule: for each DGP-by-endpoint cell, 0.35 times the smaller fit and selection mean when both are strictly positive; otherwise infeasible
planning_standard_deviation_rule: maximum of fit and selection one-sided 95 percent upper confidence limits for episode SD and the consumed V5 endpoint episode SD
selection_rule: smallest common grid N with family-power lower bound at least 0.95
no_qualifying_grid_or_nonpositive_planni: process-valid domain_robust_gate_failed before smoke or confirmation; do not weaken assumptions or expand grid
confirmation_slots: first N prospectively ordered slots from each DGP's preassigned 4500-slot maximum

nonbinding_inherited_feasibility_yardsti.method: v005 35-percent retained V5 effects extended from family 6 to family 8

runtime_storage_bound.reason: read-only local audit leaves a safety margin on the 116 GiB free volume while preserving all prior runs
